title: Assert the actual zero value, not just non-emptiness, in streak_state_provider_test.dart's 'stream emits new value' test

evidence.quote:
await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
      expect(states, isNotEmpty); // zero at start

why: The comment states the intent ('zero at start') but `expect(states, isNotEmpty)` only proves an emission arrived, not that its value is 0 -- a regression that made the initial computed streak nonzero (e.g. a restore/reduce ordering bug) would still pass this line. In practice the invariant IS protected elsewhere in the same file ('emits streak state as a stream' and 'emits empty state when no events', lines 131-141, both assert currentStreak==0 on first emission), so this specific line just doesn't pull its own weight and its comment overclaims what it checks.
acceptance_criteria: Assertion at streak_state_provider_test.dart:166 checks the emitted value equals 0, matching its own comment.
